verdict.rationale: Intuit ships an official QuickBooks Online MCP server that gives agents API access to live ledger entities and 11 financial reports, including Balance Sheet, P&L and Cash Flow. That is the data an agent needs to ground a "can we afford X?" answer. Separately, the in-app Intuit Intelligence chat answers natural-language finance questions from the company's own books. Neither source documents affordability-style answers built from API-pulled data. missing for 10: documented affordability or what-if Q&A via the API/MCP path, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent answers grounded in live ledger data.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: 11 Financial Reports - Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow, and more
It includes full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, giving you comprehensive access to QuickBooks Online functionality.
Ask anything—from “What’s driving my profit?” to “How are my invoices doing this month?”—and get instant, contextual answers in clear, concise language.
